task_type.description: Coarse classification of the task's purpose; determines which artifact classes are minimally required.

risk_level.description: Risk band derived from blast radius, reversibility, and external dependency surface.

assurance_level.description: Verification floor required by the task. Mirrors docs/artifact_schema.md §5.11.1; 'high' is NOT a valid assurance level and MUST be rejected by validators.

lifecycle_artifact.description: PDCA lifecycle artifacts owned by docs/artifact_schema.md §5.1, §5.3, §5.7, §5.6, §5.8.

governance_artifact.description: Plan-version-scoped governance JSON artifacts (manifests, policies, baselines).

code_artifact.description: Runtime code and its byte-identical template mirror; test fixtures used by quality gates.

evidence_artifact.description: Deterministic JSON evidence emitted by gate runners or PCACC; never narrative reports.

generated_document_candidate.description: Long-form prose artifacts. The matrix MAY require their PRESENCE for specific task types; it MUST NOT generate their CONTENT. Content authorship belongs to a separate task lifecycle explicitly authorizing such generation.

rules.notes: Anchor rule for TASK-1023 (v3.5 plan + manifest introduction). Code change forbidden by Prompt -1 scope lock.
Anchor rule for TASK-1024 (quality-baseline.v3.5.json). Inventory only; no remediation, no runtime code.
Anchor rule for TASK-1025 (run_quality_gates.py + quality-gate-policy.v3.5.json). Source/template pair is mandatory.
Anchor rule for TASK-1026 (run_precommit_check.py + precommit-check-policy.v3.5.json). Structural checks only; no reasoning audit.
Anchor rule for TASK-1027 itself. Policy-only; no runtime validator implementation; no document content generation.
Lightweight one-off fix. SRS/RTM/design spec/threat model are explicitly forbidden to prevent artifact bloat.
Single-purpose small feature. Decision artifact only required when conflicts/tradeoffs surface; document content remains forbidden.
Cross-module feature. design_spec is OPTIONAL (presence-only when invoked); SRS/RTM remain forbidden by default.
High-blast-radius governance work. Decision artifact mandatory. Threat model / release note / migration note are conditional (see waiver_policy and rule_application_notes).

threat_model is OPTIONAL by default; required ONLY when the change actually alters security behavior, attack surface, or trust boundaries. Conditional escalation must be recorded in the task decision artifact.

release_note / user_guide / migration_note are OPTIONAL by default; required ONLY when the change actually affects user-visible behavior or requires user-side migration. Conditional escalation must be recorded in the task decision artifact.

rule_application_notes.presence_only_evaluation: The matrix evaluates ARTIFACT PRESENCE against required/optional/forbidden lists for the matched (task_type, risk_level, assurance_level) tuple. It does NOT evaluate artifact content quality, semantic correctness, or schema conformance. Content quality belongs to docs/artifact_schema.md and the runners under artifacts/scripts/.
rule_application_notes.conditional_escalation: Where a generated_document_candidate (threat_model, release_note, user_guide, migration_note, design_spec) appears in optional_artifacts, escalation to required is allowed ONLY when the task's decision artifact explicitly records the trigger condition (e.g. 'security behavior changed', 'user-visible behavior changed'). Escalation MUST NOT be inferred silently.
rule_application_notes.rule_resolution_priority: When multiple rules could match a task, the most specific (task_type, risk_level, assurance_level) tuple wins. Anchor rules AOM-001..AOM-005 take precedence over generic rules AOM-006..AOM-011 for their respective task types.
rule_application_notes.no_runtime_validator_in_v3_5_0: TASK-1027 does NOT implement a matrix validator. Validator implementation is deferred to a future task lifecycle that explicitly authorizes it; that future task MUST cite this matrix as input.

notes: Completed tasks are NOT retroactively re-evaluated under a newer matrix.
Superseded tasks freeze their original obligation state at the moment of supersession.
Superseding tasks inherit still-open obligations from the superseded task UNLESS explicitly waived by a decision artifact under the waiver_policy.
Matrix changes apply ONLY from the new effective_from forward; an updated matrix MUST declare a new effective_from and a new matrix_version.
Tasks completed before TASK-1027 (effective_from anchor) are NOT automatically non-compliant; they remain advisory under their original obligations.
If a legacy task is materially modified after TASK-1027 (state transition, scope change, or artifact rewrite beyond cosmetic edits), the current matrix obligations apply to the modified scope.
If a legacy task is superseded after TASK-1027, the superseding task follows the current matrix in full.
Waivers MUST be declared inside a decision artifact under '## Guard Exception' or an equivalent structured block; narrative-only paragraphs are NOT valid waivers.
All six required_waiver_fields MUST be present; missing any one invalidates the waiver regardless of other content.
owner MUST reference a human reviewer or accountable maintainer (not an AI agent label).
evidence_ref MUST point to a verify artifact path under artifacts/verify/.
expires_at MUST be present and enforceable; expired waivers MUST be treated as invalid by any future matrix validator.
v3.5.0 explicitly forbids creating a standalone waiver registry or style debt registry; if data later justifies one, it is deferred to v3.5.2.

forbidden_generation.scope: TASK-1027 MUST NOT generate the CONTENT of any of the listed artifact classes. The matrix MAY define when these artifacts are required or optional for OTHER tasks; it MUST NOT author them.
notes: The matrix is an anti-bloat presence control, not a document generation plane.
Future authorship of any listed class belongs to a separate task lifecycle whose decision artifact explicitly authorizes content generation.

limitations: Presence-only: the matrix does NOT evaluate content quality, semantic correctness, or schema conformance.
No runtime validator is implemented in TASK-1027; matrix enforcement is deferred to a future task lifecycle.
Conservative task_type taxonomy: 11 task types are enumerated; new task types require a new matrix_version with a new effective_from.
Risk level and assurance level remain coarse (4 and 3 values); finer-grained gating is deferred.
Rule resolution priority is fixed (anchor rules > generic rules); compound matchers (e.g. multi-type tasks) require a future matrix revision.
Conditional escalation of generated_document_candidate artifacts MUST be recorded in the task decision artifact; the matrix itself does NOT decide escalation.
Legacy tasks completed before effective_from are advisory only; the matrix does NOT retroactively invalidate prior governance work.
Waivers live alongside their target artifact via decision_artifact_only mechanism; no global registry exists in v3.5.0.
Superseded tasks freeze original obligations; superseding tasks inherit open obligations unless explicitly waived.
TASK-1027 is the v3.5.0 minimum-obligation control; v3.5.1 / v3.5.2 / v3.6 evolution requires new task lifecycles with their own decision artifacts.
